items.detail:
Your page shows the Analysis Group Health Care Summer Analyst application moved to *interview* on November 12, five weeks after you sent it on October 8. It is your first interview of the cycle. Oldest unsent row: J&J Global Market Access, listed since October 22 (open to January 8).

Why this one moved first: it was a direct fit (health care consulting on HEOR and epidemiology work) and a firm that runs a fixed fall interview calendar. The late-September pharma batch (Gilead, Kite, Amgen, J&J, Dexcom) has been waiting six weeks or more, so expect those to answer on their own schedules.

**What Analysis Group says to expect:** the first round is *behavior based and conducted virtually*; the analyst final round is meetings with *roughly three to five consultants*. They ask about research, prior work, teamwork and career interests, and want you to talk through a quantitative project. Have two ready: the breast-cancer recurrence model (XGBoost, Brier 0.07, AUC 0.75, the R Shiny app) and the influenza SARIMA capstone. items.title: How this field hires a master's student
items.detail: Big pharma opens structured summer programs between September and November (Genentech's Product Development Data Sciences wave, master's included, went up November 11 with an eight-day window) and often prefers or requires a PhD for biostatistics seats; read the qualification line before the title. Amgen runs a separate master's internship inside its statistics group (posted October 26), next to PhD-preferred wording. Moderna's biostatistics intern names master's students outright, while its epidemiology and biomarker statistics seats are PhD only. Mid-size biotechs split the same way: Genmab's Clinical & Statistical Programming intern asks for master's students, while Insmed's biostatistics intern asks for a PhD candidate. Regeneron posted its whole 2027 summer wave on October 28; its biostatistics and clinical science seats came down by November 12 with no close date ever shown. Gilead's October 16 batch listed PhD as *preferred* on most statistics reqs and still took master's students; its research AI seats (omics, chemistry, lab work) closed October 31. Contract research organizations hire master's statisticians at volume, but later and more rolling, and mostly in SAS. Device companies run their own calendars: Edwards' clinical track came down October 31 and its other tracks open January to April; Medtronic's master's window closed October 13. Health plans posted a wave at the end of September, mostly undergraduate, MBA or pharmacy seats; the graduate analytics seats came later, with Highmark's remote seats and CVS Health's Data Science seat posted in the second half of October. Some plans post far later: SCAN Health Plan in Long Beach posted last cycle's graduate Data Scientist Intern on May 16. [SCAN posting, last cycle](https://simplify.jobs/p/94e3dc1e-3287-40a5-8a13-a3fcb9452c79) Posted close dates move, usually earlier: BMS re-posted its Patient Safety seat on November 3 with the close cut from November 26 to November 16, then took it down by November 12. BMS posted its master's-eligible Data & Quantitative Sciences intern on November 11 with a 16-day window. J&J's IDAR Analytics & Systems seat was posted November 9 with a November 16 close and came down November 10. J&J posts batches with short windows and sometimes moves them: its Oncology Epidemiology seat was re-posted October 16 with the close pushed a week to October 30. Merck's whole 2027 Future Talent wave (biostatistics, outcomes research, epidemiology) came down October 30 to 31, before its dates. Daiichi Sankyo posted its whole 2027 summer wave on its own careers site November 5 to 9, 43 seats in Basking Ridge: its R programming seats take master's students, while its Biostatistics and Data Management seat asks for a PhD student. Some big pharma statistics groups run a separate master's track with a winter deadline: last cycle Eli Lilly listed an MS Statistics intern next to its PhD seat, due January 4, and Takeda's statistics internship took PhD or master's candidates, due February 28 (both from the American Statistical Association's internship list, which it publishes each December). [ASA list, last cycle](https://stattrak.amstat.org/2025/12/01/2026-internships/) Research hospitals can run a separate route: St. Jude matches graduate students to named faculty mentors, with rolling review through December. A few cancer centers run programs written for master's students: Memorial Sloan Kettering's GEMS takes only students in a master's program, though its work is genomic. [GEMS](https://www.mskcc.org/departments/epidemiology-biostatistics/educational-opportunities/gems)

items.detail:

Research areas include wastewater surveillance and advanced molecular detection.

**Eligible:** full-time graduate student in public health or a related program, US citizen, national or permanent resident, 3.0 GPA or higher.

**To apply:** resume, unofficial undergraduate and graduate transcripts (PDFs named *last name_first name_resume*, *_ugtranscript*, *_gradtranscript*), and name, email and phone for at least two faculty references. Line those references up before you start. This is the one open, dated seat in Los Angeles on this page.

**Dates:** applications for the summer program run November 2 to January 31; decisions in March. Orientation is in person the last week of May and the program runs about nine weeks, to late July. Stipend at federal rates; orientation housing is covered.
